title: Figure 56: Effect of distance from radar to target on power density
description: Three stacked illustrations of a jet aircraft and radar beam on blue backgrounds: the first shows a beam cone labeled "Power Density decreases by 1/R²" and "A ∝ R²" over range R, the second "Power reflected back to the radar depends on the power intercepted by the target and the target orientation," and the third "Reflected power also spreads equally as it returns to the radar." The caption reads "Figure 56. Effect of Distance from the radar to the Target on the Power Density (Aerospaceweb.org, 2010)." The text explains the 1/R⁴ round-trip loss and the role of stealth in reducing detectability.
